units.source_text: 千重子的额上渗出了冷汗。

en.t: Cold sweat broke out on Chieko's forehead.

units.source_text: 她仿佛感到蜂拥在四条大街上的人群的脚步声和祇园的奏乐声都渐渐远去。

en.t: She seemed to feel the footsteps of the crowds surging along Shijo Street and the festival music of Gion gradually fading into the distance.
Everything before her eyes went dark.
